facts.text: The Bona Access Guarantee covers 100% of tuition for eligible New York students from families earning $80,000 or less.

sources.title: Bona Access Guarantee | St. Bonaventure University
sources.quote: Beginning with students entering in fall 2027, the Bona Access Guarantee will cover 100% of tuition for eligible New York State students from families with annual total incomes of $80,000 or less and typical assets.
